domain_order.description: a domain a space bought at checkout, held in the platform's registrar account; domain_registered{at, expires} once the registry holds it and it is attached, domain_refused{at, why} where it could not be registered, and domain_refunded{at, refund} once its payment is returned

space.description: the space that paid for it, whose plan its renewal follows

serves.description: the space or app it is attached to once registered

checkout.description: the paid checkout, which names the order however often its payment is told

cents.description: what the person paid, in cents: the registry's price for the first year

live.description: whether its payment moved money; a sandbox payment's order registers nothing and is refunded

domain_registered.description: a bought domain the registry holds, attached to the place it serves with its DNS written, and when its year ends

domain_refused.description: a bought domain that could not be registered, and why: a sandbox payment, a name another checkout bought first, or the registry's refusal; its payment is owed back until domain_refunded

domain_refunded.description: a refused domain order whose payment was returned whole, and the payment provider's refund

register_domain.description: register a bought domain at the registry, waiting out its workflow, then attach it to the place it serves and write every DNS record that takes in its zone; refund one that cannot be registered

renew_domains.description: turn renewal on for every domain a space bought while its plan is paid, and off once it is not
